A field guide to snacking

Guide Squeektoshi through all 50 mazes. Collect every peanut to unlock the next level.

  1. Keep those paws moving. Use arrow keys, WASD, swipe, or the direction buttons. Turns are queued until the next open corridor.
  2. Go nuts for power beans. Glowing beans let you eat snakes for 5 seconds. That drops to 3.5 seconds on levels 31–40 and 3 seconds on levels 41–50.
  3. Mind the snakes. You have 3 lives for the whole run. Later levels bring up to 4 faster snakes and fewer beans.
  4. Take a breather. Press P or Escape to pause. Switching away from the page pauses an active game too.

Your score stays local to this browser. A fresh, running Squeektoshi gives you a 10% movement boost.
